summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the results of the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders and the commencement of a Stock Option Exchange Program for non-executive employees. The meeting included director elections, ratification of auditors, advisory say-on-pay, and approval of two option exchange proposals—one for non-executives (approved) and one for executives (rejected). The exchange program launched on June 3, 2026, ends July 1, 2026, and allows non-executive employees to exchange underwater options (exercise price ≥$18.00) for fewer options at current FMV. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present.
